text: Items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.
Electronics have a 14-day return window. Original packaging required.
Refunds are processed within 5–7 business days after return is received.
We match competitor prices within 14 days of purchase. Contact support with proof.
All products carry a 12-month manufacturer warranty against defects.
Items can be exchanged for a different colour or size within 30 days.
VIP members receive free expedited shipping on all orders.
Orders can be cancelled before dispatch. Contact support immediately.
Subscriptions can be cancelled at any time. Access continues until the end of the billing period.
Gift cards do not expire and can be used towards any purchase, including sale items.
